title: Austin: Free YMCA Sewers, Gas Pump Request
summary:
*   **Community Support:** Approved free sewerage services for the Y.M.C.A. Hall and the Boy Scouts Hall.
*   **Urban Development & Regulation:** Reviewed an application to install a new gasoline pump on West Fifth Street, referring it to multiple city departments for detailed assessment.
*   **City Management Updates:** Confirmed new hires for key positions within the Water, Light, and Power Department, including a Cashier and Storekeeper.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
AUSTIN.. TEXAS. June 23, 1921.
i
The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and Searight, 5; absent, none.
The Minutes of the last meeting were read and upon motion of Councilman Copeland were
adopted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Coun- cilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; nayes, none. • The application of Fred Hart to install a gasoline pump on
West Fifth Street upon motion of Councilman Eyres, was referred to the City Engineer, City
Attorney, City Electrician and Chief of the Fire Department for their report back to the
Council. Motion prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland,
Eyres, Haynes and Searight, 5; nayes, none.
Lyman J. Bailey appeared before the Council and asked that the Y. M. C. A. Hall, at the
corner of Waller and Willow Streets ad the Boy Scouts Hall at #1000₫ Congress Avenue be
placed on the list for free sewerage, Councilman Searight moved that the application be
granted.
Motion prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres,
Haynes and Searight, 5; nayes, none.
The Council then recessed.

effective July 1st, 1921. Nomination was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor

voting.
Councilman Eyres nominated H. E. Wilkinson as Storekeeper of the Water, Light and Power
Department. Nominution was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Copeland, Haynes and Searight, 4; nayes, none, Councilman Eyres not voting A communication
from Houghton Brownlee was read, and upon motion of Councilman Eyres, was referred to

Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and Seartht, 5; nayes, none.
